scenes.title: Black Friday Laptop Purchase
scenes.description: An individual must decide whether and what computing device to purchase during Black Friday promotions. Trade-offs between performance, portability, longevity, and cost.

scenes.title: Black Friday Smartphone Purchase
scenes.description: A buyer compares flagship and mid-range phones during seasonal discounts. Decision factors include camera quality, battery, software support, and total value.

scenes.title: Home Office Equipment Upgrade
scenes.description: A remote worker plans a practical setup upgrade. The discussion balances ergonomics, productivity impact, budget limits, and long-term durability.

scenes.title: Travel Planning Discussion
scenes.description: A small group must agree on a travel destination and high-level travel plan. Collaborative planning balancing group preferences, budget, and seasonal considerations.

scenes.title: Family Trip Budget Planning
scenes.description: A family aligns on destination, lodging, and activities under a fixed budget. The plan must satisfy different age groups without overspending.

scenes.title: Multi-city Business Trip Plan
scenes.description: A team organizes a multi-stop business trip with tight schedules. It weighs cost, travel fatigue, meeting priorities, and contingency options.

scenes.title: Wildfire Mitigation Policy
scenes.description: A group engages in collaborative policy discussion addressing wildfire mitigation and long-term community resilience. Evaluating multiple policy directions.

scenes.title: Urban Flood Preparedness Policy
scenes.description: A city-level team debates flood resilience strategies. It considers drainage investment, zoning constraints, emergency response readiness, and equity impacts.

scenes.title: Heatwave Response & Resilience
scenes.description: A policy group evaluates heatwave adaptation measures for vulnerable communities. It compares cooling centers, grid stress planning, and public communication strategy.
